arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT h.UserId
FROM postHistory AS h
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = h.PostId
WHERE p.ViewCount >= 1000
  AND h.UserId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY h.UserId, h.PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;
